turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Morning everyone. Let's start with a quick round of updates on last week's items, then the rollout plan.

turns.speaker: Priya Raman
turns.text: The mockups went out Wednesday as planned, and the design is frozen. I've attached the final file to the ticket.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: The promo code reset bug is fixed, the patch was merged on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Lucas Ferreira
turns.text: I shared the country breakdown in the channel on Tuesday. Germany and France are the worst for mobile drop-off.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: And I escalated the address vendor issue with their account manager. We got production credentials on Thursday, so that blocker is gone.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: Staging was refreshed Wednesday afternoon, and I've started on the Adyen note. It should be done by Friday.

turns.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
turns.text: Regression is about halfway. I found three bugs so far, two in the address form and one in the order summary.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: Send them my way and I'll triage them tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
turns.text: Will do. I'll file the three bugs in Jira today.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Great. Now the rollout. I'd like to avoid a big-bang launch.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: Agreed. My suggestion is a staged rollout, ten percent of traffic for the beta, then fifty percent after a week if conversion holds.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Okay, let's do that. Staged rollout, ten percent first, fifty after a week.

turns.speaker: Lucas Ferreira
turns.text: I'll admit the drop-off numbers surprised me last week. Someone should probably check whether mobile drop-off changed after the promo fix. I can pull that number.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Please do. Priya, could you run a quick usability test with five users on the frozen design by Friday?

turns.speaker: Priya Raman
turns.text: Yes, I'll set that up.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: One thing that worries me is load testing. We haven't load tested the new address service at all, and if beta traffic spikes we don't really know how it behaves.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Can you own that?

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: Leave it with me, I'll figure out a plan for load testing.

turns.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
turns.text: Also, I'm blocked on test accounts for the EU stores. I can't check the VAT display without them.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I'll ask IT for EU test accounts.

turns.speaker: Priya Raman
turns.text: Should we keep gift card support in the beta? It's only half built.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: I don't think so. Let's cut gift card support from the beta and bring it back after launch.

turns.speaker: Daniel Okafor
turns.text: Fine by me, that frees up a couple of days.

turns.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
turns.text: We should probably update the help center articles at some point too, since the screens all changed.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Good point. Okay, that's it for today. Thanks all.
